title: Ball Nose Cutter for Sloped Surfaces
body: Use a ball nose cutter for sloped surfaces to handle peaks and valleys better than other cutters.

title: 45 Degree Tool Path for Slopes
body: Run a 45-degree tool path rather than a zero or 90-degree angle to provide a smoother transition and better surface finish.
